metadata.purpose: Clinical-realistic v2 retrieval evaluation subset for the cardiology guideline KG-RAG prototype restricted to CVD prevention, CVD and diabetes, elevated blood pressure and hypertension, and cardiovascular diseases during pregnancy.
metadata.section_annotation_policy: Use the most specific section or set of sections needed to answer each question; avoid adding parent sections when the answer is confined to a child section.

selection.excluded_existing_cross_document_questio: Original standard cross-document questions were excluded when any annotated source fell outside the four allowed document_ids.
selection.version_note: v2 rewrites question text only; gold references and question ids are unchanged.

metadata.question_rewrite_policy: Questions were rewritten to sound like realistic clinical or expert information needs, avoiding wording that mechanically mirrors section titles. Gold sources, document_ids, filenames, guideline names, and section annotations were left unchanged from v1.
